subject: DI05005051

body.en:
List and nutrient basis

Examples:KCl(muriate of potash),K2SO4(sulfate of potash),KNO3,potassium–magnesium sulfate and K2CO3.These names describe different chemical/secondary-nutrient properties;they are not equal replacements merely because each contains potassium. K content is conventionally reported as K2O equivalent.

Physical and chemical comparison

KCl:white/coloured crystalline soluble salt supplying chloride. K2SO4:crystalline sulfate salt supplying S, and less soluble in water than KCl under comparable ordinary conditions. KNO3:soluble nitrate salt supplying N and K;an oxidiser requiring compatible handling. K–Mg sulfate:double-salt grades supplying K, Mg, S, with hydration/stoichiometry stated. K2CO3:soluble, hygroscopic, alkaline carbonate;neutralises acids and reacts with CO2/water speciation changes.

Selection depends on actual grade, solubility, salt load, chloride sensitivity, soil/crop need and approved use—not a universal dose table.
body.gu:
List તથા Nutrient Basis

Examples:KCl(muriate of potash),K2SO4(sulfate of potash),KNO3,K–Mg sulfate તથા K2CO3. Chemical/secondary nutrients જુદાં છે;K છે એટલે equal replacement નહીં. K content સામાન્ય રીતે K2O equivalent માં છે.

Physical તથા Chemical Comparison

KCl:white/coloured soluble crystalline salt, chloride પણ આપે. K2SO4:crystalline sulfate, S આપે તથા comparable ordinary conditions માં KCl કરતાં ઓછું soluble. KNO3:soluble nitrate, N/K આપે અને oxidiser છે. K–Mg sulfate:K/Mg/Sdouble salt;hydration/stoichiometry લખવી. K2CO3:soluble, hygroscopic, alkaline carbonate;acid neutralise કરે તથા CO2/water થી speciation બદલે.

Grade, solubility, salt load, chloride sensitivity તથા soil/crop need મુજબ selection થાય છે, universal dose table થી નહીં.

Definition / selected route

KCl recovery from sylvinite separates potassium chloride from a mixed potassium/sodium chloride ore by selective dissolution/crystallisation.

Raw materials and principle

Sylvinite, qualified process brine and wash water.

Physical dissolution/crystallisation;KCl identity remains unchanged.

Source identification

Source hot-dissolution/crystallisation route:sylvinite crushing/screening, hot dissolver, NaCl-rich residue removal, vacuum coolers/crystallisers, settlers, filter, wash/cool/ship and brine/water recovery. Selective solubility and mother-liquor composition govern separation;not every potash plant uses this route.

Original reference—page 18

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source has crusher/screens, measuring bins, steam-heated dissolvers, a rundown tank, vacuum coolers/crystallisers, settlers, filter and final cooling/storage. Brine and condensate/water-recovery services support the main salt route.

1.Selective hot dissolution

Prepared ore contacts the selected hot brine so KCl is transferred preferentially into the recoverable solution under the chosen salt balance. NaCl-rich residue and insolubles leave separately. The route uses differences in solubility behaviour rather than chemically changing potassium into another element.

2.Vacuum crystallisation and finishing

Cooling/evaporation in the vacuum crystalliser creates supersaturation and KCl-rich crystals. Settling/filtering separates crystals from mother liquor;controlled washing removes adhering salts before cooling/drying as specified. Wash/brine recycle must retain selectivity and avoid impurity buildup.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Ore variability, brine composition, NaClcontamination, crystal size, scale, water balance and caking need control.

Applications / product boundary

Potassium fertilizer and qualified chemical feed;chloride-sensitive applications require assessment.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Sylvinite, qualified process brine તથા wash water.

Physical dissolution/crystallisation;KCl identity remains unchanged.

Source ની ઓળખ

Source hot-dissolution/crystallisation માં sylvinite crushing/screening, hot dissolver, NaCl-rich residue separation, vacuum crystallisers, settlers, filter, wash/cool તથા brine recovery છે. Selective solubility/mother liquor મહત્વનાં છે;બધી potash plants નો route આ નથી.

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 18

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Source માં crusher/screens, bins, steam-heated dissolvers, rundown tank, vacuum crystallisers, settlers, filter તથા cooling/storage છે. Brine/condensate recovery મુખ્ય salt route ને support કરે છે.

1.Selective Hot Dissolution

Prepared ore selected hot brine ને contact કરીને chosen balance મુજબ KCl recoverable solution માં આપે છે. NaCl-rich residue/insolubles અલગ પડે છે. Solubility નો ભેદ વપરાય છે, potassium નું element બદલાતું નથી.

2.Vacuum Crystallisation તથા Finishing

Vacuum crystalliser માં cooling/evaporation થી supersaturation તથા KCl-rich crystals બને છે. Settler/filter mother liquor અલગ કરે છે;washing adhering salts દૂરકરે છે. Brine/wash recycle માં selectivity/impurity control જોઈએ.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Ore variability, brine composition, NaClcontamination, crystal size, scale, water balance/caking નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Potassium fertilizer/qualified chemical feed;chloride-sensitive uses નું assessment જોઈએ.

Definition / selected route

Potassium nitrate is recovered here from KCl/NaNO3 mixed-salt conversion and selective crystallisation.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified KCl and sodium-nitrate solutions in a licensed industrial process.

KCl+NaNO3⇌KNO3+NaCl(separation-driven).

Source identification

Original stirred steam-heated kettle takes KCl/NaNO3;settler/filter remove NaCl-rich crystals before the cooler crystallises KNO3. Water and mother-liquor management control recovery. This is an industrial overview only;no oxidiser synthesis recipe or quantities.

Original reference—page 20

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source shows a stirred heated kettle, a NaClsettler, filter press and product-cooling/crystallisation duty. Separate solid outlets prevent salt residue from being called the final KNO3 product.

1.Mixed-salt equilibration and NaClremoval

The salt system is contacted under the selected industrial solubility regime. NaCl-rich solids are separated in the settling/filtration section, altering the residual liquor composition. Recovery depends on phase equilibria and separation, not merely the formal double-displacement equation.

2.Product crystallisation and qualification

The selected cooling step yields KNO3-rich crystals for qualified separation and analysis. Mother liquor requires a balanced recovery/purge route. This is an oxidiser-manufacturing overview:no laboratory charges, temperatures, concentration targets or energetic mixing instructions are provided.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Product NaClcontent, mother-liquor losses, oxidiser incompatibility and effluent control are key issues.

Applications / product boundary

Qualified N/K fertilizer or specified industrial grade;no energetic-use guidance.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

The supplied potassium-sulphate route is aqueous sodium-sulphate/KCl conversion with staged crystallisation.

Raw materials and principle

KCl, sodium sulphate and process water/brine.

2KCl+Na2SO4⇌K2SO4+2NaCl(separation-driven).

Source identification

The source is a water-based Na2SO4/KCl conversion with staged concentration, crystallisation, filtration and mother-liquor recycle. It is not the Mannheim KCl/H2SO4 furnace process;that can only be a separately identified alternative. Mixed-salt phase behaviour permits recovery.

Original reference—page 19

Construction and equipment arrangement

The original block sheet includes salt-solution preparation, conversion, filtration, first-stage concentration/crystallisation/filtration, then second-stage recovery with mother-liquor return and vapour condensation. It is not a Mannheim acid furnace.

1.Conversion and selective solids

The mixed-salt aqueous system develops product and intermediate salt phases according to its composition. Separation of a K2SO4-rich fraction and management of KCl/sulfate-containing intermediate solids shift the recoverable balance. The source indicates several solids routes rather than an instantaneous complete reaction.

2.Staged recovery and recycle

Concentration/crystallisation stages recover additional salts, including a NaCl-rich fraction. Mother liquor returns where its composition supports conversion;vapour condensation recovers water. Impurity accumulation limits recycle and requires a controlled purge. Product composition is verified analytically.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Mixed-salt selectivity, scale, crystal purity, water/energy balance and brine discharge govern the route.

Applications / product boundary

K/S fertilizer, particularly where chloride load must be considered;actual agronomic choice needs testing.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

KCl, Na2SO4 તથા process water/brine.

2KCl+Na2SO4⇌K2SO4+2NaCl(separation-driven).

Source ની ઓળખ

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 19

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Original sheet માં solution preparation, conversion, filtration, first/second-stage concentration-crystallisation-filtration, motherliquor return/vapour condensation છે. Mannheim acid furnace નથી.

1.Conversion તથા Selective Solids

Mixed-salt aqueous system composition મુજબ product/intermediate phases આપે છે. K2SO4-rich fraction તથા KCl/sulfate intermediates નું separation balance બદલે છે. Source માંઅનેક solid routes છે, instantcomplete reaction નહીં.

2.Staged Recovery તથા Recycle

Stages વધારાના salts સાથે NaCl-rich fraction recover કરે છે. Composition યોગ્યહોયત્યાં motherliquor return અને vapour condensation થી water recovery થાય છે. Impurity buildup માટે purge તથા product analysis જોઈએ.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Mixed-salt selectivity, scale, purity, water/energy balance તથા brine discharge મહત્વનાં છે.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Definition / selected route

Potassium magnesium sulphate is a K/Mg/Sdouble-salt fertilizer;the selected schoenite basis has1:1K2SO4:MgSO4 with stated hydration.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified KCl and magnesium-sulphate brine.

2KCl+2MgSO4+6H2O⇌K2SO4·MgSO4·6H2O+MgCl2(representative hydrate basis).

Source identification

Selected1:1 double-salt basis matches the syllabus K2SO4·MgSO4;hydration must be stated. Langbeinite K2SO4·2MgSO4 is a different stoichiometry, not a silent substitute.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

The study has feed qualification, a controlled conversion vessel, crystalliser, solid separator/wash system and grade-specific drying/packing. Hydrate formation is part of product identity, not an irrelevant moisture correction.

1.Double-salt formation

Brine chemistry is adjusted within the selected licensed process so the desired K–Mg sulfate hydrate becomes a recoverable phase. Both magnesium and potassium balances matter;the retained mother liquor may be MgCl2-rich. The formation of a double salt is different from physically mixing two arbitrary powders.

2.Separation and hydration control

Crystals are separated/washed and conditioned without unintentionally changing the specified hydrate or retaining excessive mother-liquor salts. Testing verifies K, Mg, S, chloride/moisture and physical form. Langbeinite has a different2MgSO4 stoichiometry and cannot silently replace the syllabus1:1 material.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control salt phase, hydration, chloride contamination, caking and recovery yield.

Applications / product boundary

Qualified K/Mg/S fertilizer;commercial stoichiometry and hydration must be declared.

K/Mg/S આપતું double-salt fertilizer છે;selected schoenite માં 1:1K2SO4:MgSO4 તથા stated hydration છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Qualified KCl તથા MgSO4 brine.

2KCl+2MgSO4+6H2O⇌K2SO4·MgSO4·6H2O+MgCl2(representative hydrate basis).

Source ની ઓળખ

Selected1:1 double-salt syllabusK2SO4·MgSO4 સાથે મેળ ખાય છે;hydration લખવી. LangbeiniteK2SO4·2MgSO4 નું stoichiometry જુદું છે, તે silently substitute ન કરવું.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Study માં feed qualification, conversion vessel, crystalliser, separator/wash તથા grade-specific drying/packing છે. Hydrate product identity નો ભાગ છે, ફક્ત irrelevant moisture correction નહીં.

1.Double-salt Formation

Selected process માં brine chemistry થી desired K–Mg sulfate hydrate recoverable phase બને છે. K/Mg બંને balance જોઈએ;mother liquor MgCl2-rich હોઈ શકે. Double-salt formation arbitrary powders mixing થી જુદું છે.

2.Separation તથા Hydration Control

Crystals separate/wash/condition કરતાં specified hydrate બદલાવું કે વધુ mother-liquor salts રહેવું ન જોઈએ. K, Mg, S, chloride/moisture/physical form તપાસાય છે. Langbeinite માં 2MgSO4 છે;syllabus1:1 material નો silent substitute નહીં.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Salt phase, hydration, chloride contamination, caking/recovery નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

QualifiedK/Mg/S fertilizer;stoichiometry/hydration de cl are કરવી.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

Potassium carbonate, K2CO3,is an alkaline potassium salt;one representative manufacturing route carbonates qualified potassium hydroxide.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified KOHsolution and compatible CO2 supply.

2KOH+CO2→K2CO3+H2O;excessCO2 can change bicarbonate speciation.

Source identification

One representative route uses qualified KOH and CO2;this does not claim that potassium carbonate is extracted unchanged from potash ore.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

The flow contains feed storage/qualification, a gas–liquid carbonation section, clarification/concentration, solids recovery and moisture-protected packing.

1.Carbonation and liquor control

Contacting KOHwith CO2 forms carbonate and water. Gas distribution and endpoint/speciation control determine the product liquor;excess CO2 can shift material toward bicarbonate. This is an acid–base gas-absorption process, not unchanged extraction of carbonate from every potash ore.

2.Concentration and product protection

Clarification removes permitted insolubles, then concentration and specified crystallisation/solids recovery develop the required grade. Conditioning/packing limits moisture uptake because K2CO3 is hygroscopic. Product alkalinity and carbonate/bicarbonate balance are checked.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Corrosive alkaline liquor, CO2 contact, water removal, salt deposition and hygroscopic storage require control.

Applications / product boundary

Qualified potassium/industrial chemical uses including glass and other formulations;not a universal replacement for ordinary field KCl.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

K2CO3 alkaline potassium salt છે;representative route માં qualified KOH નું carbonation થાય છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Qualified KOHsolution તથા compatible CO2 supply.

2KOH+CO2→K2CO3+H2O;excessCO2 can change bicarbonate speciation.

Source ની ઓળખ

Representative route માં qualified KOH/CO2 લેવાય છે;potash ore માંથી unchangedK2CO3 સીધું extract થાય એવો દાવો નથી.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Flow માં feed qualification, gas–liquid carbonation, clarification/concentration, solids recovery તથા moisture-protected packing છે.

1.Carbonation તથા Liquor Control

KOH/CO2 contact થી carbonate/water બને છે. Gas distribution તથા endpoint/speciation થી liquor નક્કી થાય છે;excessCO2 થી bicarbonate તરફ shift થાય છે. આ acid–base absorption છે, દરેક ore માંથી unchanged carbonate extraction નહીં.

2.Concentration તથા Product Protection

Clarification insolubles દૂરકરે છે;concentration/crystallisation થી grade મળે છે. HygroscopicK2CO3 માટે conditioning/packing moisture uptake રોકે છે. Alkalinity તથા carbonate/bicarbonate balance તપાસાય છે.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Alkaline liquor, CO2 contact, water removal, deposition/hygroscopic storage નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Qualified potassium/industrial uses, જેમ કે glass/formulations;ordinary field KCl નો universal replacement નહીં.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Potassic fertilizers—classification and properties.
q.gu: Potassic Fertilizers—Classification તથા Propertiesનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Examples:KCl(muriate of potash),K2SO4(sulfate of potash),KNO3,potassium–magnesium sulfate and K2CO3.These names describe different chemical/secondary-nutrient properties;they are not equal replacements merely because each contains potassium. K content is conventionally reported as K2O equivalent. KCl:white/coloured crystalline soluble salt supplying chloride. K2SO4:crystalline sulfate salt supplying S, and less soluble in water than KCl under comparable ordinary conditions. KNO3:soluble nitrate salt supplying N and K;an oxidiser requiring compatible handling. K–Mg sulfate:double-salt grades supplying K, Mg, S, with hydration/stoichiometry stated. K2CO3:soluble, hygroscopic, alkaline carbonate;neutralises acids and reacts with CO2/water speciation changes.
a.gu: Examples:KCl(muriate of potash),K2SO4(sulfate of potash),KNO3,K–Mg sulfate તથા K2CO3. Chemical/secondary nutrients જુદાં છે;K છે એટલે equal replacement નહીં. K content સામાન્ય રીતે K2O equivalent માં છે. KCl:white/coloured soluble crystalline salt, chloride પણ આપે. K2SO4:crystalline sulfate, S આપે તથા comparable ordinary conditions માં KCl કરતાં ઓછું soluble. KNO3:soluble nitrate, N/K આપે અને oxidiser છે. K–Mg sulfate:K/Mg/Sdouble salt;hydration/stoichiometry લખવી. K2CO3:soluble, hygroscopic, alkaline carbonate;acid neutralise કરે તથા CO2/water થી speciation બદલે.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Potassium chloride—from sylvinite.

a.en: KCl recovery from sylvinite separates potassium chloride from a mixed potassium/sodium chloride ore by selective dissolution/crystallisation. Sylvinite, qualified process brine and wash water.
a.gu: Sylvinite માંથી selective dissolution/crystallisation થી KCl ને NaCl વાળા ore થીઅલગ કરાય છે. Sylvinite, qualified process brine તથા wash water.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Potassium nitrate—salt conversion.

a.en: Potassium nitrate is recovered here from KCl/NaNO3 mixed-salt conversion and selective crystallisation. Qualified KCl and sodium-nitrate solutions in a licensed industrial process.
a.gu: અહીં KCl/NaNO3 mixed-salt conversion તથા selective crystallisation થી KNO3 મળે છે. Licensed industrial process માં qualified KCl/NaNO3 solutions.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Potassium sulphate—sodium-sulphate conversion.

a.en: The supplied potassium-sulphate route is aqueous sodium-sulphate/KCl conversion with staged crystallisation. KCl, sodium sulphate and process water/brine.
a.gu: SuppliedK2SO4 route aqueous Na2SO4/KCl conversion તથા staged crystallisation છે. KCl, Na2SO4 તથા process water/brine.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Potassium magnesium sulphate—schoenite route.
q.gu: Potassium Magnesium Sulphate—Schoenite Routeનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Potassium magnesium sulphate is a K/Mg/Sdouble-salt fertilizer;the selected schoenite basis has1:1K2SO4:MgSO4 with stated hydration. Qualified KCl and magnesium-sulphate brine.
a.gu: K/Mg/S આપતું double-salt fertilizer છે;selected schoenite માં 1:1K2SO4:MgSO4 તથા stated hydration છે. Qualified KCl તથા MgSO4 brine.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Potassium carbonate—KOH carbonation route.

a.en: Potassium carbonate, K2CO3,is an alkaline potassium salt;one representative manufacturing route carbonates qualified potassium hydroxide. Qualified KOHsolution and compatible CO2 supply.
a.gu: K2CO3 alkaline potassium salt છે;representative route માં qualified KOH નું carbonation થાય છે. Qualified KOHsolution તથા compatible CO2 supply.
